facts.business: Heranba Industries Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of agrochemicals, including herbicides, fungicides, and insecticides, with a focus on domestic and export markets.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital Commitment towards Investment with Fireside Ventures Investment Fund

guidance_or_targets.statement: Our priorities for FY27 are specific: grow domestic sales on the strength of the new marketing and wider portfolio, progress export registrations, scale our digital and farmer partnerships, and draw full value from our new ERP platform.
guidance_or_targets.metric: Domestic sales growth, export registrations, digital/farmer partnerships, ERP value realization

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text

key_risks: Revenue recognition timing and contract terms complexity
Inventory valuation risk due to obsolescence, expiry, and slow-moving stock
Foreign currency risk from USD-denominated trade receivables, borrowings, and payables
Dependence on a single customer (subsidiary) contributing ~14.40% of total revenue
Unabsorbed tax losses in subsidiaries with deferred tax assets not fully recognized on prudent basis
facts.related_party_note: Details are given in Statement -2. Current Year: Approximately 14.40% of total revenue of the Company is from a single customer - Subsidiary company.
